response.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_large_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_count FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY large_count DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive: transactions with amount >= 2400 count as large. The request says 'cutoff' without saying whether the boundary is included.
All transaction types count, both credits (PRIJEM) and withdrawals (VYDAJ/VYBER). trans.amount is stored unsigned, so the averages are over magnitudes regardless of direction.
Accounts with equal large-transaction counts are ordered by account_id ascending so the top-10 cut is deterministic.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only outgoing large transactions (withdrawals, type 'VYDAJ') with an exclusive cutoff, amount > 2400.
alternatives.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_large_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 AND type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY large_count DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;
